evidence: Film deposition was achieved with a commercial flow type-F-120 ALD reactor (ASM-Microchemistry, Finland) using nitrogen (99.999% from Air Liquide, France) as a carrier and purging gas. The standard pulsing sequence is the following: /C15pulse 1: ZrCl 4 for 1.5 s; /C15pulse 2: N 2 purge for 2 s; /C15pulse 3: H 2O for 0.5 s; /C15pulse 4: N 2 for 2 s. In the standard operating mode, both sequences are repeated during 2000 cycles.
